source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: The Immolator can split one eligible squad as Declare Battle Formations begins. Eligible squads are Sisters Novitiate Squad, Battle Sisters Squad and Dominion Squad. Assign the models to two equal halves and record where each one goes. Pick a single half to inherit Cherub if the original unit has it. Assign one half to embark in this TRANSPORT at battle start. Deploy the second half on its own or start it in a different TRANSPORT.
